types.name: Order accepted
types.description: The kitchen accepted an order and started cooking it.

body.en: The kitchen has your order and has started on it. We will let you know the moment it is ready.

types.name: Order ready
types.description: The kitchen marked an order ready — for collection, or on its way out for delivery.

body.en: Thanks for waiting — we will let you know when anything changes.

types.name: Order completed
types.description: The order was handed over — delivered, or collected at the counter.

body.en: That is your order complete. Your receipt is on your orders page — we hope you enjoyed it.
